Putting AI to work to help insurance keep its promise

Avallon is the agentic system of action for insurance claims. We’re a team in New York City building agents that keep every claim moving forward, so claims teams have time for the work that matters most.
Explore job openings

How we work

Avallon is an in-person team based in New York City. We work closely across disciplines, stay connected to our customers, and measure our work by the results it delivers. These five principles guide how we work, who we hire, and how we treat our customers.

Customer first

We put our customers at the heart of our operations and deliver value quickly.

Extreme agency

Every problem is our problem. We act before we’re asked, and nothing is “not my job”.

Engineering mindset

We think like engineers across all domains. We question assumptions, break problems down, and measure the impact of our solutions.

Simplicity is sophistication

We strip away complexity to focus on what matters.

Candid communication

We say what we mean and build trust through openness.

What you can expect

Competitive compensation

We offer strong salary and equity packages designed for a high-performing team.

Health coverage

Avallon covers 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus fertility benefits through Carrot.

Food and fitness

The team receives lunch and dinner each workday, along with a monthly gym stipend.

Time together

Semiannual offsites give the team space to step back, reconnect, and prepare for the work ahead.

Ready to help us build the future of insurance?

We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems, take ownership, and see their work put to use by insurance teams around the world.
